items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 69:1
items.html: The six upper Sefirot of Beriah are considered as if they were the discernment of a protrusion from the world of Atzilut. See above, answer 34. And they are the seventy cubits and the remainder that are added to the city, in the secret of the expansion of the city. (Item 84).
